purpose: Test 12 km to 5 km refinement on the same Indian event that generated the Stage-1 threat object.
required_inputs: same-event coarse ensemble or deterministic atmospheric slice near 12 km
independent high-resolution reference near 5 km or finer
rules: Do not substitute HRRR controlled-benchmark scores for India same-event skill.
Exact coarse consistency remains a hard diagnostic.
Diffusion cannot become default unless its pre-registered safety/adoption gate passes.
5 km means output spacing, not 5 km forecast accuracy.
blocked_by: No same-event Indian fine-resolution reference paired with the current Stage-1 events is bundled.
